description: Land Acquisition - Udagaladebokka, Minipe D/S Division, Kandy District -Pitipana South, Chilaw D/S Division, Puttalam District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes (Knuckles Conservation), including descriptions of the land, boundaries, extents, and compensation procedures. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
